name: Macaron
message: 「Nihaha, what a huge yawn. You look totally goofy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you just tired from all the patrolling?」

name: Synn
message: 「My sleep schedule hasn't really changed, so I'm fine on that front」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then you're probably tired from preparing for the Holy Night Festival」

name: Macaron
message: 「The whole time we're making our rounds, don't you feel like someone's watching us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be that Demon General we heard about, waiting for a chance to ambush us?」

name: Paqy
message: 「If that were the case, we'd have lost two or three of our guys by now」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm... If it's just my imagination, then that's fine, I guess...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, let's keep a closer eye out from now on」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Oh, hey Azel. You actually showed up today」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I think it kinda does matter」

name: Azel
message: 「...What have you lot been sniffing around for lately?」

name: Azel
message: 「You roam the academy grounds in large numbers at night」

name: Synn
message: 「You could say it's a Student Council volunteer thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, how do you know about that, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It was a coincidence... I merely heard rumors」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you do such a thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, because we want to protect everyone's safety. Plus, we got permission from Helena too」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. The world's a dangerous place, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, well, I think there's a lot of things...」

name: Azel
message: 「Can you not put it into words」

name: Azel
message: 「In this world, there is nothing worth protecting」

name: Azel
message: 「To me, this world means nothing at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone has something precious to them, so isn't it only natural to want to protect it」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you have something you want to protect, don't you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「In this world, anything precious to me is...」

name: Azel
message: 「What you people are doing is pointless」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You've got a pretty serious look on your face~」

name: Synn
message: 「A little bit, yeah. I was just wondering if Azel gets lonely being by herself all the time」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, are you aiming for Azel-chan too~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaat?! You're still pulling that same crap?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just worried she doesn't have any friends」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan~, wanna try wrapping some sarashi around your chest~?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Shouldn't you be the one to become friends with her, big brother?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, she does seem super tough to crack」

name: Macaron
message: 「Me?! Even though you couldn't do it, big brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「It might be easier to talk girl-to-girl, you know」

name: Macaron
message: 「Good point! Maybe I'll try making friends with her」

name: Macaron
message: 「Having someone left out would ruin our sparkling school life, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「So even Macaron can't breach that fortress, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it's not decided yet that we can't become friends」

name: Macaron
message: 「No matter how tough she acts, being all alone has gotta be lonely」

name: Macaron
message: 「We can just become better friends little by little from now on, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it really did feel strange, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not human, not a demon, and not an angel--just a weird aura...」
